name: ExpWPRBB
summary: This EA combines the Williams Percent Range (WPR) oscillator with Bollinger Bands to identify overbought and oversold reversal conditions. It enters long positions when WPR is oversold and price is near the lower Bollinger Band, and enters short positions when WPR is overbought and price is near the upper Bollinger Band. Exits are triggered by opposite signals or when price reaches the opposite Bollinger Band.
summary_zh: 该EA结合威廉指标(WPR)和布林带(Bollinger Bands)来识别超买超卖反转条件。当WPR处于超卖区且价格接近布林带下轨时做多，当WPR处于超买区且价格接近布林带上轨时做空。出场依靠反向信号或价格到达对侧布林带。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于均值回归原理，利用WPR振荡器判断市场超买超卖状态，配合布林带确认价格偏离均值的程度。入场条件为双重确认：WPR进入超卖区（低于-80）且价格触及或跌破布林带下轨时开多单；WPR进入超买区（高于-20）且价格触及或突破布林带上轨时开空单。出场条件包括价格回归至布林带中轨时平仓，或出现反向信号时平仓。仓位管理采用固定手数或基于资金比例的动态仓位计算方式。资金管理方面，EA可能提供止损设置选项，但核心逻辑依赖布林带的统计偏差作为隐含止损参考。整体策略在震荡市中表现较佳，但在趋势行情中可能产生连续亏损信号。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on mean reversion principles, using the WPR oscillator to identify overbought/oversold market conditions combined with Bollinger Bands to confirm the degree of price deviation from the mean. Entry conditions require dual confirmation: long positions are opened when WPR enters oversold territory (below -80) and price touches or breaks below the lower Bollinger Band; short positions are opened when WPR enters overbought territory (above -20) and price touches or breaks above the upper Bollinger Band. Exit conditions include closing positions when price reverts to the Bollinger Band middle line or when an opposite signal appears. Position sizing may use fixed lots or a dynamic calculation based on account equity percentage. Money management aspects likely include configurable stop loss options, though the core logic relies on Bollinger Band statistical deviation as an implicit stop reference. The overall strategy performs better in ranging markets but may generate consecutive losing signals during strong trending conditions.

parameters.name: MagicNumber
parameters.description: EA魔术编号，用于识别本EA的订单
parameters.description_en: EA magic number for identifying this EA's orders

pros: 双重指标确认减少假信号，WPR与布林带互补验证提高入场可靠性
均值回归策略在震荡行情中表现优秀，盈亏比相对合理
参数可调性强，布林带周期和偏差倍数可适应不同市场波动环境
pros_en: Dual indicator confirmation reduces false signals, WPR and Bollinger Bands complement each other to improve entry reliability
Mean reversion strategy performs well in ranging markets with reasonable risk-reward ratios
Highly configurable parameters allow Bollinger Band period and deviation multiplier to adapt to different market volatility environments
cons: 均值回归策略在强趋势行情中容易连续亏损，缺乏趋势过滤机制
默认止损设为0意味着依赖布林带回归出场，极端行情下可能造成重大亏损
缺乏新K线检查机制，可能在同一根K线上重复开仓导致过度交易
cons_en: Mean reversion strategy is prone to consecutive losses in strong trending markets due to lack of trend filtering mechanism
Default stop loss of 0 means relying on Bollinger Band mean reversion for exit, which can cause significant losses during extreme market moves
Lack of new bar check mechanism may cause repeated entries on the same bar leading to over-trading
improvements: 增加趋势过滤器（如ADX或大周期均线），在趋势行情中暂停交易或反转策略逻辑
添加新K线检查和持仓检查机制，避免重复开仓和过度交易
实现动态止损，基于布林带带宽或ATR设置自适应止损水平
improvements_en: Add a trend filter (such as ADX or a long-period moving average) to pause trading or reverse strategy logic during trending markets
Implement new bar check and position check mechanisms to prevent duplicate entries and over-trading
Implement dynamic stop loss based on Bollinger Band width or ATR for adaptive stop levels

risk_points: 默认止损为0，在极端单边行情中无硬性止损保护，可能导致大额亏损
缺乏趋势行情过滤，均值回归策略在趋势市场中有持续逆势开仓风险
risk_points_en: Default stop loss of 0 provides no hard stop protection in extreme one-way markets, potentially leading to large losses
Lack of trend filtering creates continuous counter-trend entry risk when the market is trending
